subject: a NumPy training loop for a small two-layer classifier with early stopping
conclusion: tinyclf trains in shuffled mini-batches, checks the validation loss after each epoch, keeps the best checkpoint and stops early.
why: Early stopping on a held-out split guards against overfitting. The best checkpoint, not the last one, is the model you keep.

glossary.definition: one full pass over the training split
ending training when the validation loss has not improved for a set number of epochs

flow.title: One epoch of training
flow.text: A loop: batches, forward pass, loss, update, then an evaluation that decides whether the next epoch starts.

items.label: Batch
items.desc: The data step shuffles the training split and yields mini-batches in a new order each epoch.

items.label: Forward
items.desc: The forward pass runs two dense layers and a softmax to get class probabilities.

items.label: Loss
items.desc: The loss step computes cross-entropy and the gradient for every parameter.

items.label: Update
items.desc: The optimiser clips the gradient norm and moves each parameter against its gradient.

items.label: Evaluate
items.desc: After each epoch the loop measures validation loss and accuracy without updating anything.

items.label: Stop
items.desc: The loop stops when the validation loss has not improved for the patience window.

relations.when: no improvement for the patience window
relations.label: stop

facts.text: The loop saves a checkpoint only when the validation loss improves.
The patience window is five epochs in the shipped configuration.

inferred: With the fixed seed, two runs on the same machine give the same loss curve.

lines.name: batches
lines.text: Each epoch starts with a fresh shuffle into mini-batches.

lines.name: step
lines.text: Every batch runs forward, gets a loss and updates the weights.

lines.name: decide
lines.text: Then the loop evaluates, and either starts the next epoch or stops.

lines.name: best
lines.text: The run keeps the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss.

lines.name: summary
lines.text: It also reports how many epochs ran and the final accuracy.
